areas.authorization: R: Sloan’s Lake extended package, 9 Oct 2026
areas.extentMethod: WGS84 meridional/prime-vertical scale at bbox midpoint; 0.25 m padding per edge to enclose corners in the existing ENU rectangle.
areas.detailPolicy: Full core LOD0 and reduced LOD1 available for every cell; existing coarse context beyond the core. Consumer selects detail; renderer unchanged.
